fullContent:
Indushekhara Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Ayurved Sarsangrah, edition 17, page no – 253. 
 Indushekhara Rasa is an Ayurvedic medicine available in the tablet form. This medicine is given to the pregnant ladies in different problems like fever, cough, respiratory problems, nausea, vomiting, weakness etc. Ingredients used in the formulation of this product are very effective to improve the functions of liver and spleen. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shilajeet – Asphaltum 
 Abharak bhasma 
 Rasa sindoor 
 Praval bhasma 
 Lauh bhasma 
 Swarnamakshik bhasma 
 Shudh harital 
 Juice of each of these herbs: 
 Bhringraj 
 Arjuna 
 Nirgundi 
 Adusa 
 Lotus 
 Jalkamal 
 Kuda 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Make the powder of ingredients from 1-7 and triturate with decoction or juice of each ingredient from 8-14 for 11 times. Tablets of 125 mg are made. 
 Dosage 
 Take the tablet of 125 mg Take 1-2 tablets with honey or water morning and evening daily. 
 Indications 
 It is given to the pregnant ladies for different problems like fever, cough, respiratory problems, nausea, vomiting, weakness etc. 
 It also manages bleeding diarrhea, low digestive fire, lethargy and nervine weakness. 
 Side Effects 
 Take this medicine only under medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
